text: A doc comment or shipped document states a fact about the code that no test computes, and it is wrong. Article IX reaches a fact held in two places; a single unguarded claim falls outside it, which is why this recurs. Instances in one session: a rule count of five where the tree had eight, four names where the tool resolves a different set, 612 declaration names that do not reproduce, one performance magnitude written three ways across a comment and two commit bodies, a limit said to cut three ways where two reviewers each found a further face, and a release commit asserting that a version moves no verdict where its own test pins one that moves. Every one was found by a reviewer rather than by the suite. The answer applied here was to compute the claim in a test per face, which then fails when the claim stops holding.
source: six instances across this session, 2026-09-04; five found by review, one by re-measuring

text: The seventh instance landed inside the commit written about the pattern: a message said each face of a limit is load-bearing because cutting one makes a mutant stop failing, where what stops failing is that one test and not the suite. Deleting the prefix and middle assertions and re-adding the hyphen, two pre-existing tests still catch it. Redundant coverage is not a defect; the claim of unique coverage was the defect, and it was written in prose beside tests that could have been asked.
source: codex adversarial review of 448ea3a..19b01dc, 2026-09-04; reproduced here

text: a shipped document stating what the runtime does is outside every guard the repository has, because the subject is external: the mirror tests hold spec-facts to harnex's own constants and the stamp digest hashes only those sets, so a prose bullet claiming Stop discards additionalContext stayed green while 59 records already on disk disproved it

the pattern library holds the routine that answers a failure this repository then had, and nothing connects the two: review-stale-learnings asks whether a shortcoming still holds under the current model, write-only-signal-census asks which kinds nothing reads, and this repository adopts neither of the ten shipped patterns

a guard's own output contract is restated in a rule file, a second rule file and the code's doc comment, and the prose-sync guard beside it watches two named constants rather than the contract: the floor has carried the same triplication untested, so the seam reproduces wherever a guard speaks a hook contract

a reviewer given a frozen tree can settle everything except what the runtime does with what the tree emits, and that is exactly where the tree's own claims went stale: the two questions this review could not reach were the two the transcript corpus answered, so a review over source and a measurement over transcripts are different instruments rather than one done twice
